assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a wide landscape editorial illustration for an article titled 'From Instagram DMs to Paid Brand Deals: An Influencer’s Guide'. Main subject: a large natural handshake between two people sealing a creative brand partnership, one arm in a muted burnt-coral sleeve and the other in pale ice-blue, shown as a strong central silhouette. Beside and slightly behind the hands is a small distinctive hand-drawn creator camera with its lens facing us. Two small warm copper coin circles near the camera suggest the paid collaboration. Rich deep teal background fills the whole frame edge to edge. Hand-painted gouache and coloured-pencil texture, expressive charcoal contours, natural imperfect brushwork, sophisticated print-magazine illustration. Small soft coral/ice-blue accents. The handshake, camera and coins must be readable as three simple large shapes at thumbnail size. Strong diagonal composition, substantial negative space, everything important inside central 75% for a wide 2.1:1 crop. No text, no writing, no logos, no watermark. Absolutely no paper sheets, documents, campaign briefs, envelopes, receipts, folders, phones, laptop, plants, beige/cream background, yellow/ochre background, neon, glossy 3D, photorealism or extra objects. Hands anatomically plausible, five fingers each, one coherent handshake. Single image, not a collage.

Dusty navy, burgundy, sage and pale blue palette, warm skin on the human hand. Equal visual hierarchy, four clearly distinct methods. No claims of product capabilities or safety.
